past.title: Creative Music Guild Presents: Scott Amendola -
past.body:
Scott Amendola

September 16, 2026 — 7pm

$10 Suggested Donation, sliding scale

The Creative Music Guild’s Outset Series welcomes acclaimed drummer, composer, and bandleader Scott Amendola for a special evening of creative music and community. Known for his work with Nels Cline, Charlie Hunter, Jenny Scheinman, and numerous innovative projects spanning jazz, improvisation, and experimental music, Amendola brings his adventurous musical spirit to Portland for a unique performance and open session.

Following the featured set, the evening will open into a community improvisation jam, inviting musicians of all backgrounds and experience levels to participate. Bring your instrument, your curiosity, and your listening ears as we explore spontaneous music-making together
